title: token-efficiency.md's backlog.py command count matches the parser
goal: the MCP tools for commands section of kb/_self/token-efficiency.md gives backlog.py's command count as the parser has it, or names the command that counts it

run:
import sys; sys.path.insert(0, '_tools')
import re, backlog
t = open('kb/_self/token-efficiency.md', encoding='utf-8').read()
m = re.search(r'backlog\.py` alone has (\d+) commands', t)
n = len(backlog.USAGE)
print('doc:', m and m.group(1), 'parser:', n); sys.exit(0 if (m is None or int(m.group(1)) == n) else 1)

clauses.clause: the MCP tools for commands section of kb/_self/token-efficiency.md gives backlog.py's command count as the parser has it, or names the command that counts it
